verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only LLM-driven delegation primitives: handoffs and agents-as-tools. It never documents an explicit graph or workflow construct with branching, loops, or parallel steps. Delegation primitives are adjacent building blocks, not the composed-workflow capability the story asks for, so the applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose agents into an explicit graph or workflow with branching, loops, and parallel steps
